one_line: Rana Sanga of Mewar, Rajput ruler and war-leader, at the 1519 siege of Gagron facing Sultan Mahmud Khalji II of Malwa.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned warrior’s build and a slight battle-worn limp.
appearance.face: Angular Rajput face with high cheekbones, sharp nose, deep-set dark brown eyes, wheatish complexion darkened by sun, a long narrow scar running diagonally across his left cheek, and a default expression of calm, intense focus with a restrained, dignified half-frown.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair streaked subtly with grey, tied back in a low warrior’s knot at the nape; a simple red cotton pagri (turban) wrapped close to the head with a narrow gold border and a small upright white heron feather tucked on the left side.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved quilted cotton angarkha in muted off-white with fine vertical stitching, he wears a dark bottle-green mail-and-plate coat (zirh-baktar) reaching mid-thigh, its steel plates hinted beneath; a deep saffron-orange cotton patka (waist sash) is wrapped firmly around his waist, knotted on his left hip with its ends hanging to knee level; below, he has loose white churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles and sturdy brown leather riding boots; over his shoulders sits a short dark-red woollen shawl draped like a mantle for the cool fort winds; minimal jewellery: a single thin gold kada on his right wrist and small gold studs in both ears, and a practical plain steel finger ring on his left hand.
appearance.signature: A long straight Rajput talwar with a gently curving single-edged blade, an iron cross-guard hilt wrapped in dark-brown leather, and a simple steel disc pommel, carried sheathed at his left hip in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with subtle brass fittings.

ref_desc: Rana Sanga is a tall, broad-shouldered Rajput in a bottle-green mail coat over an off-white quilted angarkha, saffron-orange waist sash, white churidar trousers, brown riding boots, red pagri with white feather, facial scar, and a plain-hilted talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rana Sanga at the 1519 siege of Gagron: a tall, broad-shouldered mid-40s Rajput war-leader with an angular, sun-darkened face, high cheekbones, sharp nose, deep-set dark brown eyes, and a narrow scar running diagonally across his left cheek, wearing a calm, intense expression; his thick black hair with slight grey is tied in a low knot and wrapped with a simple red cotton pagri with a narrow gold border and a small upright white feather on the left side. Dress him in an off-white long-sleeved quilted angarkha under a dark bottle-green mail-and-plate coat that reaches mid-thigh, with a deep saffron-orange cotton waist sash tightly wrapped and knotted on his left hip, its ends hanging to the knee; show loose white churidar trousers gathered at the ankles, sturdy brown leather riding boots, and a short dark-red woollen shawl draped over his shoulders like a mantle. Add minimal jewellery: a thin gold bangle on his right wrist, small gold stud earrings, and a plain steel ring on his left hand. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon, a straight Rajput talwar with a slightly curving blade, simple iron cross-guard, dark-brown leather-wrapped hilt, and plain disc pommel, sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard with subtle brass fittings. Use a palette dominated by deep red, saffron orange, bottle green, off-white, and brown leather, and present him in neutral, front and three-quarter poses to clearly show face, hair, garments, and weapon details.
